title: Sutra-khanda, part 1 (portion 01)
html:
The blessing: the mangala-shloka; praise of Ganesha, of Shiva and Parvati, of Sarasvati and of the Vaishnavas; obeisance to the Lord, His associates and the author's guru Narahari; Murari Gupta and his Sanskrit book, the model of this poem; the beginning of the "sutra", a brief list of the pastimes of the Adi-khanda

Mangalacharana (The Blessing)

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.1 Having sung the glory of Sri Krishna Chaitanya, the author prays for the merciful grace first of the Vaishnavas and then of his own guru, Sri Narahari Thakura; he bows at the feet of the countless associates of Gaura-lila, known to him and unknown; praying for the blessing of guru and Vaishnavas, he declares that the model of his book, a panchali-prabandha, is the Sanskrit poem of Sri Murari Gupta called Sri Chaitanya-charita; and he briefly states what will be written in the Adi-, Madhya- and Shesha-khanda.

Mangala-shloka (Sanskrit)2

Glory to the Lord in the form of Chaitanya, crest-jewel of sannyasis! —
He who gladdens the devotees by giving away heaps of priceless jewels of bhakti and prema,
who descended in full in the age of Kali to free the devotees from their distress,
and who crushes the unbelievers of the three worlds with the thunderbolt-goad of His roar.

Raga patha-manjari

নমো নমো বন্দোঁ দেব গণেশ্বর, বিঘ্নবিনাশন মহাশয় ।
একদন্ত মহাকায়, সর্বকার্যে সহায়, জয় জয় পার্বতীতনয় ॥ ১ ॥

namo namo bandoṁ deba gaṇeśbara, bighnabināśana mahāśaẏa |
ekadanta mahākāẏa, sarbakārye sahāẏa, jaẏa jaẏa pārbatītanaẏa || 1 ||

namo namo — obeisance, obeisance; bando — I praise; deva — god; ganeshvara — Ganeshvara; vighna-vinashana — destroyer of obstacles; mahashaya — great one; ekadanta — one-tusked; mahakaya — huge-bodied; sarva-karye — in every work; sahaya — helper; jaya jaya — glory, glory; parvati-tanaya — son of Parvati

1I bow, I bow, I praise you, god Ganeshvara,
great destroyer of obstacles;
one-tusked, huge of body, helper in every work —
glory, glory to the son of Parvati!3

হরগৌরী বন্দোঁ মাথে, জুড়িয়া যুগল হাতে, চরণে পড়িয়া করোঁ সেবা ।
ত্রিজগতে এক কর্তা, বিষ্ণুভক্তি-বরদাতা, সবে এক এই দেবী দেবা ॥ ২ ॥

haragaurī bandoṁ māthe, juṛiẏā yugala hāte, caraṇe paṛiẏā karoṁ sebā |
trijagate eka kartā, biṣṇubhakti-baradātā, sabe eka ei debī debā || 2 ||

hara-gauri — Hara and Gauri; bando — I praise; mathe — with my head; judiya — joining; yugala hate — both hands; charane — at the feet; padiya — falling; karo seva — I serve; tri-jagate — in the three worlds; eka karta — sole doers; vishnu-bhakti-varadata — granting the boon of bhakti to Vishnu; sabe eka — all in one; ei devi deva — this goddess and god

2I bow my head to Hara and Gauri, joining my palms;
falling at their feet, I serve them:
the sole doers in the three worlds, granting the boon of bhakti to Vishnu —
these two are to me all the gods and goddesses.

সরস্বতী বন্দোঁ মুণ্ডে, কেলি কর মোর তুণ্ডে, কহ গৌরহরি-গুণগাথা ।
অবিদিত ত্রিজগতে, গৌরবে বাণীনাথে, অদ্ভুত অপরূপ কথা ॥ ৩ ॥

sarasbatī bandoṁ muṇḍe, keli kara mora tuṇḍe, kaha gaurahari-guṇagāthā |
abidita trijagate, gaurabe bāṇīnāthe, adbhuta aparūpa kathā || 3 ||

sarasvati — Sarasvati; bando munde — I praise with my head; keli kara — play; mora tunde — on my tongue (lips); kaha — tell; gaurahari-guna-gatha — the tale of Gaurahari's virtues; avidita — unknown; tri-jagate — to the three worlds; gaurave — in greatness; vaninathe — to the Lord of speech (Brahma); adbhuta aparupa katha — a wondrous unprecedented tale

3I bow my head to Sarasvati: play upon my tongue,
tell the tale of the virtues of Gaurahari —
unknown to the three worlds, unknown even to the Lord of speech in all his greatness4 —
a wondrous, unprecedented tale.

কাকু করোঁ দেবগণে, আর যত গুরুজনে, বিঘ্ন না করিহ কেহো ইথি ।
না চাহোঁ সম্পদ-বর, মুঞি অতি পামর, নির্বিঘ্নে সম্পূর্ণ হউ পুথি ॥ ৪ ॥

kāku karoṁ debagaṇe, āra yata gurujane, bighna nā kariha keho ithi |
nā cāhoṁ sampada-bara, muñi ati pāmara, nirbighne sampūrṇa hau puthi || 4 ||

kaku karo — I humbly beseech; deva-gane — the gods; ara yata gurujane — and all the elders; vighna na kariha — do not obstruct; keho — anyone; ithi — here; na chaho — I do not ask; sampada-vara — wealth and boons; muni ati pamara — I am most wretched; nirvighne — without hindrance; sampurna hau — let be completed; punthi — the book

4Humbly I beseech the gods and all my venerable elders:
let no one put obstacles here.
I ask neither wealth nor boons — I am the lowest of the low:
let the book be completed without hindrance.

বিষ্ণুভক্ত বন্দোঁ আগে, যত যত মহাভাগে, যাঁর গুণে পৃথিবী পবিত্র ।
সর্বজীবে করে দয়া, বিশেষে আরতি পাঞা, ত্রিভুবন-মঙ্গল চরিত্র ॥ ৫ ॥

biṣṇubhakta bandoṁ āge, yata yata mahābhāge, yāṁra guṇe pṛthibī pabitra |
sarbajībe kare daẏā, biśeṣe ārati pāñā, tribhubana-maṅgala caritra || 5 ||

vishnu-bhakta — devotees of Vishnu; bando age — I praise first; yata yata mahabhage — all the great fortunate ones; yanra gune — by whose virtues; prithivi pavitra — the earth is pure; sarva-jive kare daya — they show mercy to all beings; visheshe — especially; arati pana — finding longing; tribhuvana-mangala — a blessing to the three worlds; charitra — their conduct

5First of all I praise the devotees of Vishnu, all those great fortunate ones
by whose virtues the earth is made pure:
they are merciful to all living beings, and above all to those in whom they find longing [for God];
their lives are a blessing to the three worlds.

মুঞি অতি অভাজন, না বুঝোঁ ডাহিন-বাম, আকাশ ধরিতে চাহোঁ বাহে ।
অন্ধে দিব্যরত্ন বাছে, পর্বত না দেখে কাছে, না জানি কি পরিণামে হয়ে ॥ ৬ ॥

muñi ati abhājana, nā bujhoṁ ḍāhina-bāma, ākāśa dharite cāhoṁ bāhe |
andhe dibyaratna bāche, parbata nā dekhe kāche, nā jāni ki pariṇāme haẏe || 6 ||

muni ati abhajana — I am quite unworthy; na bujho — I do not know; dahina-vama — right and left; akasha dharite chaho — I want to seize the sky; bahe — with my arms; andhe — a blind man; divya-ratna bachhe — chooses heavenly gems; parvata na dekhe kachhe — does not see the mountain nearby; na jani — I do not know; ki parinama haye — what the end will be

6I am quite unworthy, I do not know right from left,
and yet I want to seize the sky with my arms;
a blind man choosing heavenly gems, who does not see even the mountain beside him —
I do not know what the end will be.

সবে এক ভরসা আছে, প্রভু নাহি কাহো বাছে, গুণ গায় উত্তম অধমে ।
সর্বজীবে সমদয়া, সবে পায় পদছায়া, অধিকারী নাহিক নিয়মে ॥ ৭ ॥

sabe eka bharasā āche, prabhu nāhi kāho bāche, guṇa gāẏa uttama adhame |
sarbajībe samadaẏā, sabe pāẏa padachāẏā, adhikārī nāhika niẏame || 7 ||

sabe eka bharasa achhe — there is only one hope; prabhu nahi kaho bachhe — the Lord sifts out no one; guna gaya — sing His glories; uttama adhame — high and low; sarva-jive sama-daya — equal mercy to all beings; sabe paya — all obtain; pada-chhaya — the shade of His feet; adhikari — who is qualified; nahika niyame — there is no rule

7I have but one hope: the Lord rejects no one —
high and low alike sing His glories;
to all living beings He is equally merciful, to all He gives the shade of His feet,
He keeps no rule of who is worthy.

যে পুন বৈষ্ণবজন, তার কথা কহি শুন, অকারণে দয়া সর্বলোকে ।
পর লাগি জীবন, পর লাগি ভূষণ, পর-উপকারে মানে সুখে ॥ ৮ ॥

ye puna baiṣṇabajana, tāra kathā kahi śuna, akāraṇe daẏā sarbaloke |
para lāgi jībana, para lāgi bhūṣaṇa, para-upakāre māne sukhe || 8 ||

ye puna vaishnava-jana — and the Vaishnavas; tara katha kahi shuna — I speak of them, hear; akarane daya — causeless mercy; sarva-loke — to all people; para lagi jivana — life for others; para lagi bhushana — adornment for others; para-upakare — in doing others good; mane sukhe — they find happiness

8And the Vaishnavas — hear of them:
they are causelessly merciful to all people,
they live for others, adorn themselves for others,
and find their happiness in the good of others.

ঠাকুর শ্রীনরহরি, দাস-প্রাণ-অধিকারী, যাঁর পদ-প্রতি আশে আশ ।
গৌরগুণ গাহিবারে, অধমেহ সাধ করে, সে ভরসা এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৯ ॥

ṭhākura śrīnarahari, dāsa-prāṇa-adhikārī, yāṁra pada-prati āśe āśa |
gauraguṇa gāhibāre, adhameha sādha kare, se bharasā e locanadāsa || 9 ||

thakura sri narahari — Thakura Sri Narahari; dasa-prana-adhikari — master of his servant's life; yanra pada-prati ashe asha — in whose feet is all hope; gaura-guna gahibare — to sing Gaura's virtues; adhameha sadha kare — even a low one longs; se bharasa — on that relies; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

9Thakura Sri Narahari, master of his servant's life —
my hope is in his feet;
low though I am, I long to sing the virtues of Gaura —
this is what Lochana Dasa trusts in.

তাঁর পদ-পরসাদে, গাইব অনবসাদে, এই মোর ভরসা অন্তর ।
সে দুইখানি চরণ, ইষ্টসিদ্ধি-কারণ, হৃদয়ে থুইব নিরন্তর ॥ ১০ ॥

tāṁra pada-parasāde, gāiba anabasāde, ei mora bharasā antara |
se duikhāni caraṇa, iṣṭasiddhi-kāraṇa, hṛdaẏe thuiba nirantara || 10 ||

tanra pada-parasade — by the grace of his feet; gaiba — I shall sing; anavasade — without weariness; ei mora bharasa antara — this is my heart's hope; se duikhani charana — those two feet; ishta-siddhi-karana — the cause of attaining the desired; hridaye thuiba — I shall keep in my heart; nirantara — unceasingly

10By the grace of his feet I shall sing without weariness —
this is the hope of my heart;
those two feet, the cause of attaining what I desire,
I keep in my heart unceasingly.

Raga kedara

জয় জয় শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য নিত্যানন্দ ।
জয়াদ্বৈতচন্দ্র জয় গৌরভক্তবৃন্দ ॥ ১১ ॥

jaẏa jaẏa śrīkṛṣṇacaitanya nityānanda |
jaẏādbaitacandra jaẏa gaurabhaktabṛnda || 11 ||

jaya jaya — glory, glory; sri-krishna-chaitanya — to Sri Krishna Chaitanya; nityananda — to Nityananda; jaya advaitachandra — glory to Advaitachandra; jaya gaura-bhakta-vrinda — glory to Gaura's devotees

11Glory, glory to Sri Krishna Chaitanya and Nityananda,
glory to Advaitachandra, glory to the devotees of Gaura!

জয় নরহরি-গদাধর-প্রাণনাথ ।
কৃপা করি কর প্রভু শুভ দৃষ্টিপাত ॥ ১২ ॥

jaẏa narahari-gadādhara-prāṇanātha |
kṛpā kari kara prabhu śubha dṛṣṭipāta || 12 ||

jaya — glory; narahari-gadadhara-prananatha — to the Lord of the life of Narahari and Gadadhara; kripa kari — being merciful; kara prabhu — cast, Lord; shubha drishtipata — an auspicious glance

12Glory to the Lord of the life of Narahari and Gadadhara!
Be merciful, Lord, cast Your auspicious glance on me.

করুণাভরণ সব হেম-গোরা গা ।
বন্দিয়া গাইব সে শীতল রাঙ্গা পা ॥ ১৩ ॥

karuṇābharaṇa saba hema-gorā gā |
bandiẏā gāiba se śītala rāṅgā pā || 13 ||

karuna-abharana — adorned with compassion; saba — wholly; hema-gora ga — golden fair body; bandiya — bowing; gaiba — I shall sing; se shitala ranga pa — those cool rosy feet

13His golden, fair body is all adorned with compassion;
bowing down, I shall sing of those cool, rosy feet.

সকল ভকত লঞা বৈসহ আদরে ।
ও-পদ-শীতল-বা লাগুক কলেবরে ॥ ১৪ ॥

sakala bhakata lañā baisaha ādare |
o-pada-śītala-bā lāguka kalebare || 14 ||

sakala bhakata lana — with all the devotees; vaisaha — be seated; adare — lovingly (B: asare — in the assembly); o-pada-shitala-va — the cool breeze of those feet; laguka — let it touch; kalevare — my body

14With all the devotees, be pleased to sit [here] in love:
let the breeze of those cool feet touch my body.

শচীর দুলাল প্রভু করোঁ পরণাম ।
তিলেক করুণা-দিঠে কর অবধান ॥ ১৫ ॥

śacīra dulāla prabhu karoṁ paraṇāma |
tileka karuṇā-diṭhe kara abadhāna || 15 ||

shachira dulala — darling of Shachi; prabhu — Lord; karo paranama — I bow; tileka — for a moment; karuna-dithe — with a merciful glance; kara avadhana — give heed

15Darling of Shachi, Lord, I bow to You:
for even a moment turn Your merciful glance on me.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-গোসাঞি দেবশিরোমণি ।
যাঁর পদ-পরসাদে ধন্য এ ধরণী ॥ ১৬ ॥

adbaita-ācārya-gosāñi debaśiromaṇi |
yāṁra pada-parasāde dhanya e dharaṇī || 16 ||

advaita-acharya-gosani — Advaita Acharya Gosani; deva-shiromani — crest-jewel of the gods; yanra pada-parasade — by the grace of whose feet; dhanya e dharani — this earth is blessed

16Advaita Acharya Gosani, crest-jewel of the gods —
by the grace of His feet this earth is blessed.

বন্দিয়া গাইব সে সীতার প্রাণনাথ ।
করুণা করহ প্রভু করোঁ যোড়হাত ॥ ১৭ ॥

bandiẏā gāiba se sītāra prāṇanātha |
karuṇā karaha prabhu karoṁ yoṛahāta || 17 ||

bandiya gaiba — bowing, I shall sing; se sitara prananatha — that Lord of Sita's life; karuna karaha — be merciful; prabhu — Lord; karo yoda-hata — I join my palms

17Bowing down, I shall sing of Him, the Lord of Sita's life:
be merciful, Lord — I pray with joined palms.

অভিন্ন-চৈতন্য সে ঠাকুর অবধূত ।
নিত্যানন্দরাম বন্দোঁ রোহিণীর সুত ॥ ১৮ ॥

abhinna-caitanya se ṭhākura abadhūta |
nityānandarāma bandoṁ rohiṇīra suta || 18 ||

abhinna-chaitanya — non-different from Chaitanya; se thakura avadhuta — that Thakura, the Avadhuta; nityananda-rama — Nityananda-Rama; bando — I praise; rohinira suta — the son of Rohini

18He is not different from Chaitanya — that Thakura, the Avadhuta,
Nityananda-Rama; I praise the son of Rohini.

গোরাগুণ-গরবে গর্গ মাতোয়ার ।
বন্দিয়া গাইব আগে চরণ তাঁহার ॥ ১৯ ॥

gorāguṇa-garabe garga mātoẏāra |
bandiẏā gāiba āge caraṇa tāṁhāra || 19 ||

gora-guna-garave — with pride in Gora's virtues; garga — Garga; matoyara — enraptured; bandiya gaiba — bowing, I shall sing; age — first; charana tanhara — his feet

19Garga, enraptured with pride in the virtues of Gora5 —
bowing down, I first sing of his feet.

মিশ্র পুরন্দর বন্দোঁ বিশ্বম্ভরের পিতা ।
শচী-ঠাকুরাণী বন্দোঁ ঠাকুরের মাতা ॥ ২০ ॥

miśra purandara bandoṁ biśbambharera pitā |
śacī-ṭhākurāṇī bandoṁ ṭhākurera mātā || 20 ||

mishra purandara — Mishra Purandara; bando — I praise; vishvambharera pita — father of Vishvambhara; shachi-thakurani — Shachi Thakurani; thakurera mata — mother of the Thakura

20I praise Mishra Purandara, father of Vishvambhara;
I praise Shachi Thakurani, mother of the Thakura.

লক্ষ্মী-ঠাকুরাণী বন্দোঁ বিদিত সংসারে ।
প্রভুর বিরহ-সর্প দংশিল যাহারে ॥ ২১ ॥

lakṣmī-ṭhākurāṇī bandoṁ bidita saṃsāre |
prabhura biraha-sarpa daṃśila yāhāre || 21 ||

lakshmi-thakurani — Lakshmi Thakurani; bando — I praise; vidita samsare — renowned in the world; prabhura viraha-sarpa — the serpent of separation from the Lord; damshila yahare — stung her

21I praise Lakshmi Thakurani, renowned in the world —
the serpent of separation from the Lord stung her.6

নবদ্বীপময়ী বন্দোঁ বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া মা ।
যাঁর অলঙ্কার সে প্রভুর রাঙ্গা পা ॥ ২২ ॥

nabadbīpamaẏī bandoṁ biṣṇupriẏā mā |
yāṁra alaṅkāra se prabhura rāṅgā pā || 22 ||

navadvipamayi — [lady] of Navadvipa; bando — I praise; vishnupriya ma — Vishnupriya-ma; yanra alankara — whose ornament; se prabhura ranga pa — those rosy feet of the Lord

22I praise Vishnupriya-ma, [the lady] of Navadvipa:
her ornament is the rosy feet of the Lord.

পুণ্ডরীক বিদ্যানিধি বন্দিব সানন্দে ।
যাঁর লাগি মহাপ্রভু ফুকারিয়া কান্দে ॥ ২৩ ॥

puṇḍarīka bidyānidhi bandiba sānande |
yāṁra lāgi mahāprabhu phukāriẏā kānde || 23 ||

pundarika vidyanidhi — Pundarika Vidyanidhi; bandiba — I shall praise; sanande — joyfully; yanra lagi — for whom; mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu; phukariya kande — weeps aloud

23Joyfully I praise Pundarika Vidyanidhi,
for whom Mahaprabhu wept aloud.7

পণ্ডিত-গোসাঞি সে বন্দিব একমনে ।
ঈশ্বর-মাধব-পুরীর বন্দিয়া চরণে ॥ ২৪ ॥

paṇḍita-gosāñi se bandiba ekamane |
īśbara-mādhaba-purīra bandiẏā caraṇe || 24 ||

pandita-gosani — Pandita Gosani; se bandiba — him I shall praise; eka-mane — with one mind; ishvara-madhava-purira — of Ishvara and Madhava Puri; bandiya charane — bowing at the feet

24With one mind I praise Pandita Gosani8;
I bow at the feet of Ishvara Puri and Madhava Puri.

গোসাঞি গোবিন্দ বন্দোঁ আর বক্রেশ্বর ।
গৌরপদ-কমলে যে মত্ত মধুকর ॥ ২৫ ॥

gosāñi gobinda bandoṁ āra bakreśbara |
gaurapada-kamale ye matta madhukara || 25 ||

gosani govinda — Govinda Gosani; bando — I praise; ara vakreshvara — and Vakreshvara; gaura-pada-kamale — at Gaura's lotus feet; ye matta madhukara — who are intoxicated bees

25I praise Govinda Gosani and Vakreshvara —
intoxicated bees at the lotus feet of Gaura.

পুরী যে পরমানন্দ আর বিষ্ণুপুরী ।
গদাধরদাস সে বন্দিব শিরোপরি ॥ ২৬ ॥

purī ye paramānanda āra biṣṇupurī |
gadādharadāsa se bandiba śiropari || 26 ||

puri ye paramananda — Puri Paramananda; ara vishnupuri — and Vishnupuri; gadadharadasa — Gadadhara Dasa; se bandiba — I shall praise; shiropari — [their feet] upon my head

26Puri Paramananda and Vishnupuri,
and Gadadhara Dasa I praise — [their feet] upon my head.

গুপ্ত বেজা বন্দিব হরিষ-মনোরথে ।
গোরাগুণ গাঙ যদি দয়া কর চিতে ॥ ২৭ ॥

gupta bejā bandiba hariṣa-manorathe |
gorāguṇa gāṅa yadi daẏā kara cite || 27 ||

gupta beja — Gupta the vaidya; bandiba — I shall praise; harisha-manorathe — with joyful longing; gora-guna gau — I shall sing Gora's virtues; yadi daya kara chite — if you are kind at heart

27Gupta the vaidya9 I praise with joyful longing:
be kind at heart, that I may sing the virtues of Gora.

শ্রীবাস-ঠাকুর বন্দোঁ আর হরিদাস ।
বাসুদত্ত-মুকুন্দ-চরণে করোঁ আশ ॥ ২৮ ॥

śrībāsa-ṭhākura bandoṁ āra haridāsa |
bāsudatta-mukunda-caraṇe karoṁ āśa || 28 ||

shrivasa-thakura — Srivasa Thakura; bando — I praise; ara haridasa — and Haridasa; vasu-datta-mukunda-charane — in the feet of Vasu Datta and Mukunda; karo asha — I set my hope

28I praise Srivasa Thakura and Haridasa;
in the feet of Vasu Datta and Mukunda is my hope.

রায় রামানন্দ বন্দোঁ পিরীতের ঘর ।
পণ্ডিত জগদানন্দ বন্দোঁ নিরন্তর ॥ ২৯ ॥

rāẏa rāmānanda bandoṁ pirītera ghara |
paṇḍita jagadānanda bandoṁ nirantara || 29 ||

raya ramananda — Ramananda Raya; bando — I praise; piritera ghara — abode of love; pandita jagadananda — Pandita Jagadananda; nirantara — unceasingly

29I praise Ramananda Raya, the abode of love;
unceasingly I praise Pandita Jagadananda.

রূপ-সনাতন বন্দোঁ পণ্ডিত দামোদর ।
রাঘব-পণ্ডিত বন্দোঁ প্রণতি-বিস্তর ॥ ৩০ ॥

rūpa-sanātana bandoṁ paṇḍita dāmodara |
rāghaba-paṇḍita bandoṁ praṇati-bistara || 30 ||

rupa-sanatana — Rupa and Sanatana; bando — I praise; pandita damodara — Pandita Damodara; raghava-pandita — Raghava Pandita; pranati-vistara — with countless obeisances

30I praise Rupa and Sanatana, Pandita Damodara;
I praise Raghava Pandita, bowing without end.

শ্রীরাম-সুন্দর-গৌরীদাস-আদি যত ।
নিত্যানন্দ-সঙ্গী বন্দোঁ যতেক ভকত ॥ ৩১ ॥

śrīrāma-sundara-gaurīdāsa-ādi yata |
nityānanda-saṅgī bandoṁ yateka bhakata || 31 ||

sri-rama-sundara-gauridasa-adi yata — Sri Rama, Sundara, Gauridasa and all the rest; nityananda-sangi — companions of Nityananda; bando — I praise; yateka bhakata — all the devotees

31Sri Rama, Sundara, Gauridasa and all the rest,
the companions of Nityananda, all the devotees — I praise.

কুলের ঠাকুর বন্দোঁ ইষ্টদেবতা ।
ইহলোকে পরলোকে সেই সে রক্ষিতা ॥ ৩২ ॥

kulera ṭhākura bandoṁ iṣṭadebatā |
ihaloke paraloke sei se rakṣitā || 32 ||

kulera thakura — the master of the family; bando — I praise; ishta-devata — chosen object of worship; iha-loke para-loke — in this world and the next; sei se rakshita — he is the protector

32I praise the master of our family, my chosen object of worship:10
in this world and the next he is my protector.

তাহা বিনু নাহি মোর তিনলোকে বন্ধু ।
নরহরিদাস বন্দোঁ গৌরগুণসিন্ধু ॥ ৩৩ ॥

tāhā binu nāhi mora tinaloke bandhu |
naraharidāsa bandoṁ gauraguṇasindhu || 33 ||

taha vinu — without him; nahi mora — I have no; tina-loke bandhu — friend in the three worlds; naraharidasa — Narahari Dasa; bando — I praise; gaura-guna-sindhu — ocean of Gaura's virtues

33Without him I have no friend in the three worlds;
I praise Narahari Dasa, ocean of Gaura's virtues.

গোবিন্দ মাধব ঘোষ বাসু ঘোষ আর ।
ভূমে পড়ি কর যোড়ি করোঁ নমস্কার ॥ ৩৪ ॥

gobinda mādhaba ghoṣa bāsu ghoṣa āra |
bhūme paṛi kara yoṛi karoṁ namaskāra || 34 ||

govinda madhava ghosha — Govinda and Madhava Ghosha; vasu ghosha ara — and Vasu Ghosha; bhume padi — falling to the ground; kara yodi — joining palms; karo namaskara — I bow

34To Govinda and Madhava Ghosha and to Vasu Ghosha,
falling to the ground, with joined palms, I bow.

বন্দিব শ্রীবৃন্দাবনদাস একচিতে ।
জগত মোহিত যাঁর ভাগবতগীতে ॥ ৩৫ ॥

bandiba śrībṛndābanadāsa ekacite |
jagata mohita yāṁra bhāgabatagīte || 35 ||

bandiba — I shall praise; sri-vrindavana-dasa — Sri Vrindavana Dasa; eka-chite — with one mind; jagata mohita — the world is enchanted; yanra bhagavata-gite — by whose song, the Bhagavata

35With one mind I praise Sri Vrindavana Dasa,
by whose song, the Bhagavata,11 the world is enchanted.

বন্দনা গাইতে ভাই হইবে অনুক্ষণ ।
ঘরের ঠাকুর বন্দোঁ আর রঘুনন্দন ॥ ৩৬ ॥

bandanā gāite bhāi haibe anukṣaṇa |
gharera ṭhākura bandoṁ āra raghunandana || 36 ||

bandana gaite — singing praises; bhai — brothers; haibe anukshana — could go on without end; gharera thakura — the Deity (Thakura) of the house; bando — I praise; ara raghunandana — and Raghunandana

36Brothers, one could sing praises without end;
I praise the Deity of our house and Raghunandana.12

সকল-মহান্ত-প্রিয় শ্রীরঘুনন্দন ।
প্রভু যাঁরে আগে দিলা মাল্য-চন্দন ॥ ৩৬+১ ॥

sakala-mahānta-priẏa śrīraghunandana |
prabhu yāṁre āge dilā mālya-candana || 36+1 ||

sakala-mahanta-priya — beloved of all the mahantas; sri-raghunandana — Sri Raghunandana; prabhu — the Lord; yanre — to whom; age — before [all]; dila — gave; malya-chandana — garland and sandal

36+1Sri Raghunandana, beloved of all the mahantas —
him to whom the Lord, before all others, gave a garland and sandal.13

শিশুকালে শ্রীমূর্তিরে লাড়ু খাওয়াইল ।
তাঁহারে মনুষ্যবুদ্ধি কেহো না করিল ॥ ৩৭ ॥

śiśukāle śrīmūrtire lāṛu khāoẏāila |
tāṁhāre manuṣyabuddhi keho nā karila || 37 ||

shishu-kale — in childhood; sri-murtire — to the Deity; ladu khaoyaila — fed laddus; tanhare — him; manushya-buddhi — as a mere man; keho na karila — no one regarded

37As a child he fed laddus to the Sri Murti14 —
no one took him for an ordinary man.

তাঁর পিতা বন্দোঁ শ্রীমুকুন্দদাস ।
চৈতন্য-সম্মত-পথে নির্মল বিশ্বাস ॥ ৩৮ ॥

tāṁra pitā bandoṁ śrīmukundadāsa |
caitanya-sammata-pathe nirmala biśbāsa || 38 ||

tanra pita — his father; bando — I praise; sri-mukunda-dasa — Sri Mukunda Dasa; chaitanya-sammata-pathe — on the path approved by Chaitanya; nirmala vishvasa — pure faith

38I praise his father, Sri Mukunda Dasa,
whose faith is pure on the path approved by Chaitanya.

কারো নাম জানি কারো নাম নাহি জানি ।
সভারে বন্দিল সভে মোর শিরোমণি ॥ ৩৯ ॥

kāro nāma jāni kāro nāma nāhi jāni |
sabhāre bandila sabhe mora śiromaṇi || 39 ||

karo nama jani — some names I know; karo nama nahi jani — some I do not know; sabhare bandila — I have praised all; sabhe mora shiromani — all are the crown on my head

39Some names I know, some I do not;
I praise them all: all of them are the crown on my head.

মহান্ত বন্দিব আর মহান্তের জন ।
এক ঠাঞি বন্দি গাই সভার চরণ ॥ ৪০ ॥

mahānta bandiba āra mahāntera jana |
eka ṭhāñi bandi gāi sabhāra caraṇa || 40 ||

mahanta bandiba — I shall praise the mahantas; ara mahantera jana — and the people of the mahantas; eka thani — in one place; bandi gai — I praise and sing; sabhara charana — the feet of all

40I praise the mahantas and the people of the mahantas;
in one place I praise and sing the feet of all.

আগে পাছে বিচার না কর কেহো মনে ।
অক্ষরানুরোধে বন্দনা না হয় ক্রমে ॥ ৪১ ॥

āge pāche bicāra nā kara keho mane |
akṣarānurodhe bandanā nā haẏa krame || 41 ||

age pachhe — before and after; vichara na kara — do not judge; keho mane — anyone in mind; akshara-anurodhe — for the sake of the metre (lit. by the demand of syllables); bandana na haya krame — the praises are not in order

41Let no one judge in his mind who comes first and who after:
for the sake of the metre the praises are not in order.

যার নাম নাহি কৈলুঁ ভ্রমেতে বন্দনা ।
শত পরণাম করি অপরাধ মার্জনা ॥ ৪২ ॥

yāra nāma nāhi kailuṁ bhramete bandanā |
śata paraṇāma kari aparādha mārjanā || 42 ||

yara nama — whose name; nahi kailun — I did not make; bhramete — by mistake; bandana — praise; shata paranama kari — I make a hundred obeisances; aparadha marjana — [I ask] pardon of the offence

42Those whom by mistake I have not named in my praise —
to them a hundred obeisances: forgive me the offence.

পৃথিবীর ভকত বন্দোঁ অন্তরীক্ষচারী ।
সভার চরণে একে একে নমস্করি ॥ ৪৩ ॥

pṛthibīra bhakata bandoṁ antarīkṣacārī |
sabhāra caraṇe eke eke namaskari || 43 ||

prithivira bhakata — the devotees of earth; bando — I praise; antariksha-chari — roaming the sky; sabhara charane — at the feet of all; eke eke — one by one; namaskari — I bow

43I praise the devotees who live on earth and who roam the sky;
I bow at the feet of each, one by one.

গোরাগুণ গাও সুখে পড় প্রীতি-আশে ।
আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে গায় এ লোচনদাসে ॥ ৪৪ ॥

gorāguṇa gāo sukhe paṛa prīti-āśe |
ānanda-hṛdaẏe gāẏa e locanadāse || 44 ||

gora-guna gao — sing Gora's virtues; sukhe — with joy; pada — recite; priti-ashe — in hope of love; ananda-hridaye — with a jubilant heart; gaya — sings; e lochanadase — this Lochana Dasa

44Sing the virtues of Gora with joy, in hope of love —
so sings Lochana Dasa with a jubilant heart.15

Raga varadi; disha: "Brothers dear as life, I will tell, I will tell you my own tale! — Murchha: — Ah, what is this, ah, O my life! — First I beg the blessing of all the great fortunate ones; then shall I sing the tale of [Gaura's] virtues"

মো ছার অধমাধম কি জানিমু তত্ত্ব ।
গোরাগুণ-চরিত্রের কি কব মহত্ত্ব ॥ ৪৫ ॥

mo chāra adhamādhama ki jānimu tattba |
gorāguṇa-caritrera ki kaba mahattba || 45 ||

mo chhara — I, worthless; adhamadhama — lowest of the low; ki janimu tattva — what do I know of the truth; gora-guna-charitrera — of Gora's virtues and deeds; ki kaba mahattva — what shall I say of the greatness

45I am worthless, lowest of the low — what do I know of the truth?
What can I say of the greatness of Gora's virtues and deeds?

না জানিঞা প্রলাপ করিয়া কিবা কাজ ।
উত্তমজনের ঠাঞি ঠেকিলেই লাজ ॥ ৪৬ ॥

nā jāniñā pralāpa kariẏā kibā kāja |
uttamajanera ṭhāñi ṭhekilei lāja || 46 ||

na janina — not knowing; pralapa kariya — babbling; kiba kaja — what use; uttama-janera thani — before worthy people; thekilei laja — to stumble is shame

46Not knowing, to babble on — what good is that?
To stumble before worthy people is a shame.

অধিকারী নহোঁ তবু করোঁ পরমাদ ।
গোরাগুণ-মাধুরীতে বড় লাগে সাধ ॥ ৪৭ ॥

adhikārī nahoṁ tabu karoṁ paramāda |
gorāguṇa-mādhurīte baṛa lāge sādha || 47 ||

adhikari naho — I am not qualified; tabu — yet; karo paramada — I dare (lit. commit an error); gora-guna-madhurite — for the sweetness of Gora's virtues; bada lage sadha — great longing arises

47I am not qualified, and yet I dare:
so strongly am I drawn by the sweetness of Gora's virtues.

মুরারিগুপ্ত বেজা বৈসে নবদ্বীপে ।
নিরন্তর রহে গোরাচাঁদের সমীপে ॥ ৪৮ ॥

murārigupta bejā baise nabadbīpe |
nirantara rahe gorācāṁdera samīpe || 48 ||

murari-gupta beja — Murari Gupta the vaidya; vaise navadvipe — lives in Navadvipa; nirantara rahe — always stays; gorachandera samipe — near Gorachanda

48Murari Gupta, the vaidya, lives in Navadvipa;
he is always near Gorachand.

তাঁহার মহিমা কেবা পারয়ে কহিতে ।
হনুমান বলি যাঁর খ্যাতি পৃথিবীতে ॥ ৪৯ ॥

tāṁhāra mahimā kebā pāraẏe kahite |
hanumāna bali yāṁra khyāti pṛthibīte || 49 ||

tanhara mahima — his greatness; keba paraye kahite — who can describe; hanumana bali — as Hanuman; yanra khyati prithivite — whose fame on earth

49Who could describe his greatness?
On earth he is renowned as Hanuman16 —

সমুদ্র লঙ্ঘিয়া যে বা লঙ্কাপুরী দহে ।
সীতার বার্তা উদ্ধারিয়া শ্রীরামেরে কহে ॥ ৫০ ॥

samudra laṅghiẏā ye bā laṅkāpurī dahe |
sītāra bārtā uddhāriẏā śrīrāmere kahe || 50 ||

samudra langhiya — leaping over the ocean; ye ba — he who; lankapuri dahe — burned the city of Lanka; sitara varta uddhariya — finding out the news of Sita; sri-ramere kahe — told Sri Rama

50he who leapt across the ocean and burned Lanka,
found out the news of Sita and told it to Sri Rama,

বিশল্যকরণী আনি লক্ষ্মণে জীয়ায় ।
সেই সে মুরারিগুপ্ত বৈসে নদীয়ায় ॥ ৫১ ॥

biśalyakaraṇī āni lakṣmaṇe jīẏāẏa |
sei se murārigupta baise nadīẏāẏa || 51 ||

vishalya-karani ani — bringing the vishalya-karani [herb]; lakshmane jiyaya — revived Lakshmana; sei se — that very; murari-gupta — Murari Gupta; vaise nadiyaya — lives in Nadia

51who brought the vishalya-karani herb and revived Lakshmana —
that same Murari Gupta lives in Nadia.

সর্বতত্ত্ব জানে সে প্রভুর অন্তরঙ্গ ।
গৌরপদ-অরবিন্দে ভকত প্রবীণ ॥ ৫২ ॥

sarbatattba jāne se prabhura antaraṅga |
gaurapada-arabinde bhakata prabīṇa || 52 ||

sarva-tattva jane — knows all truth; se prabhura antaranga — he is the Lord's intimate; gaura-pada-aravinde — at Gaura's lotus feet; bhakata pravina — a seasoned devotee

52He knows all the truth; he is the Lord's intimate,
a seasoned devotee of Gaura's lotus feet.

জন্ম হৈতে বালকচরিত্র যে যে কৈল ।
আদ্যোপান্তে যেই রূপে প্রেম প্রচারিল ॥ ৫৩ ॥

janma haite bālakacaritra ye ye kaila |
ādyopānte yei rūpe prema pracārila || 53 ||

janma haite — from birth; balaka-charitra — childhood deeds; ye ye kaila — whatever He did; adyopante — from beginning to end; yei rupe — how; prema pracharila — He spread prema

53All that the Lord did from His birth in childhood,
how from beginning to end He spread prema —

দামোদর-পণ্ডিত সব পুছিল তাঁহারে ।
আদ্যোপান্ত যত কথা কহিল প্রকারে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

dāmodara-paṇḍita saba puchila tāṁhāre |
ādyopānta yata kathā kahila prakāre || 54 ||

damodara-pandita — Damodara Pandita; saba puchhila tanhare — asked him about everything; adyopanta yata katha — all things from beginning to end; kahila prakare — he told in due order

54about all this Damodara Pandita questioned him,
and he told him everything from beginning to end in due order.

শ্লোকবন্ধে হৈল পুথি গৌরাঙ্গচরিত ।
দামোদর-সংবাদ মুরারি-মুখোদিত ॥ ৫৫ ॥

ślokabandhe haila puthi gaurāṅgacarita |
dāmodara-saṃbāda murāri-mukhodita || 55 ||

shloka-bandhe — in verse (shlokas); haila punthi — a book came about; gauranga-charita — of Gauranga's deeds; damodara-samvada — the dialogue with Damodara; murari-mukhodita — issued from Murari's mouth

55So came about a book of Gauranga's deeds composed in verse17 —
the dialogue with Damodara, issued from Murari's mouth.

শুনিয়া আমার মনে বাড়িল পিরীত ।
পাঁচালি-প্রবন্ধে কহোঁ গৌরাঙ্গচরিত ॥ ৫৬ ॥

śuniẏā āmāra mane bāṛila pirīta |
pāṁcāli-prabandhe kahoṁ gaurāṅgacarita || 56 ||

shuniya — hearing; amara mane — in my heart; badila pirita — love grew; panchali-prabandhe — in a sung narrative (panchali); kaho — I tell; gauranga-charita — of Gauranga's deeds

56Hearing it, I was filled with love,
and I tell of Gaura's deeds in a sung narrative, a panchali.

অধিকারী নহোঁ তবু কহোঁ এই দোষে ।
অবজ্ঞা না কর কেহো না করিহ রোষে ॥ ৫৭ ॥

adhikārī nahoṁ tabu kahoṁ ei doṣe |
abajñā nā kara keho nā kariha roṣe || 57 ||

adhikari naho — I am not qualified; tabu kaho — yet I tell; ei doshe — this is the fault; avajna na kara — do not scorn; keho — anyone; na kariha roshe — do not be angry

57I am not qualified, and yet I tell it — that is my fault;
do not scorn me, do not be angry.

অমৃত দেখিয়া কার না লাগয়ে সাধে ।
অজ্ঞান-বালক ইচ্ছে আকাশের চাঁদে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

amṛta dekhiẏā kāra nā lāgaẏe sādhe |
ajñāna-bālaka icche ākāśera cāṁde || 58 ||

amrita dekhiya — seeing nectar; kara na lagaye sadhe — who does not feel longing; ajnana-balaka — a foolish child; ichhe — desires; akashera chande — the moon in the sky

58Who, seeing nectar, is not drawn to it?
A foolish child wants [to reach] the moon in the sky.

গোরাগুণ কহিতে এছন মোর সাধ ।
এছন সময়ে চাহি বৈষ্ণব-প্রসাদ ॥ ৫৯ ॥

gorāguṇa kahite echana mora sādha |
echana samaẏe cāhi baiṣṇaba-prasāda || 59 ||

gora-guna kahite — to tell Gora's virtues; echhana mora sadha — such is my longing; echhana samaye — at this time; chahi — I ask; vaishnava-prasada — the Vaishnavas' grace

59Such is my wish — to sing the virtues of Gora;
at this hour I beg the mercy of the Vaishnavas.

বৈষ্ণব-চরণে মুঞি করোঁ পরণাম ।
গোরাগুণ গাঙ মোর এই হিয়া-কাম ॥ ৬০ ॥

baiṣṇaba-caraṇe muñi karoṁ paraṇāma |
gorāguṇa gāṅa mora ei hiẏā-kāma || 60 ||

vaishnava-charane — at the Vaishnavas' feet; muni karo paranama — I bow; gora-guna gau — to sing Gora's virtues; mora ei hiya-kama — this is my heart's desire

60I bow at the feet of the Vaishnavas:
to sing the virtues of Gora — that is my heart's desire.

আমার ঠাকুর প্রভু নরহরিদাস ।
প্রণতি-বিনতি করোঁ পূর মোর আশ ॥ ৬১ ॥

āmāra ṭhākura prabhu naraharidāsa |
praṇati-binati karoṁ pūra mora āśa || 61 ||

amara thakura — my Thakura; prabhu naraharidasa — Prabhu Narahari Dasa; pranati-vinati karo — I bow and humbly pray; pura mora asha — fulfil my hope

61My Thakura, Prabhu Narahari Dasa —
I bow and humbly pray: fulfil my desire.

Raga mara-hati; disha: "Hari, Rama, Rama, Moon among brahmanas — ah, my life!"

প্রথমে কহিব কথা অপূর্বকথন ।
আচার্যগোসাঞি কৈল গর্ভের বন্দন ॥ ৬২ ॥

prathame kahiba kathā apūrbakathana |
ācāryagosāñi kaila garbhera bandana || 62 ||

prathame kahiba katha — first I shall tell the story; apurva-kathana — an unprecedented account; acharya-gosani — Acharya Gosani; kaila garbhera bandana — worshipped the womb (the One within it)

62First of all I will tell an unprecedented tale:
how Acharya Gosani18 worshipped [the Lord in] the womb.

পৃথিবীতে জনম লৈল ত্রিজগতনাথ ।
সাঙ্গোপাঙ্গ যত যত পারিষদ-সাথ ॥ ৬৩ ॥

pṛthibīte janama laila trijagatanātha |
sāṅgopāṅga yata yata pāriṣada-sātha || 63 ||

prithivite — on earth; janama laila — took birth; tri-jagata-natha — the Lord of the three worlds; sangopanga — with intimates and retinue; yata yata parishada-satha — with all His companions

63The Lord of the three worlds came to earth,
with all His companions, intimates and retinue;

মাতা-পিতা বালক লালেন যেনমতে ।
অন্নপ্রাশনে নাম থুইল হরষেতে ॥ ৬৪ ॥

mātā-pitā bālaka lālena yenamate |
annaprāśane nāma thuila haraṣete || 64 ||

mata-pita — mother and father; balaka lalena — raise the child; yenamate — how; annaprashane — at the annaprashana (first rice-feeding); nama thuila — gave a name; harashete — joyfully

64how father and mother raised the child,
how at the annaprashana they joyfully gave Him a name.

বাল্যচরিত্র-কথা কহিব বিধান ।
শূন্য-চরণে শুনি নূপুর-নিসান ॥ ৬৫ ॥

bālyacaritra-kathā kahiba bidhāna |
śūnya-caraṇe śuni nūpura-nisāna || 65 ||

balya-charitra-katha — the tale of childhood deeds; kahiba vidhana — I shall tell in order; shunya-charane — on bare (empty) feet; shuni — is heard; nupura-nisana — the sound of ankle-bells

65I shall tell in due order the pastimes of childhood:
[how] the jingle of ankle-bells was heard from bare feet;

পরশি অশুচি দেশ চলে আচম্বিতে ।
আপন মায়েরে জ্ঞান কহিলা যেমতে ॥ ৬৬ ॥

paraśi aśuci deśa cale ācambite |
āpana māẏere jñāna kahilā yemate || 66 ||

parashi ashuchi desha — touching unclean places; chale achambite — suddenly goes; apana mayere — to His own mother; jnana kahila — spoke knowledge; yemate — how

66how He suddenly went about touching unclean places,
and how He instructed His mother in knowledge;

পুরনারীগণ কহে বুঝিতে চরিত ।
তার বোলে নারিকেল আনিলা ত্বরিতে ॥ ৬৭ ॥

puranārīgaṇa kahe bujhite carita |
tāra bole nārikela ānilā tbarite || 67 ||

pura-nari-gana kahe — the women of the town speak; bujhite charita — to understand His ways; tara bole — at their word; narikela anila — He brought a coconut; tvarite — at once

67the women of the town spoke, to understand His ways,
and at their word He at once brought a coconut;

কুক্কুর-শাবক লঞা খেলায় ঠাকুর ।
দেখিয়া সকল লোক আনন্দ প্রচুর ॥ ৬৮ ॥

kukkura-śābaka lañā khelāẏa ṭhākura |
dekhiẏā sakala loka ānanda pracura || 68 ||

kukkura-shabaka lana — taking a puppy; khelaya thakura — the Thakura plays; dekhiya — seeing; sakala loka — all the people; ananda prachura — abundant joy

68the Thakura plays with a puppy —
seeing it, everyone is full of joy;

বালকের সঙ্গে খেলা করে রাজপথে ।
গুপ্ত বেজা প্রকাশ দেখিল যেনমতে ॥ ৬৯ ॥

bālakera saṅge khelā kare rājapathe |
gupta bejā prakāśa dekhila yenamate || 69 ||

balakera sange — with the children; khela kare — plays; rajapathe — on the royal road; gupta beja — Gupta the vaidya; prakasha dekhila — saw the revelation; yenamate — how

69He plays with the children on the royal road —
and how Gupta the vaidya beheld His revelation;

বালক-সহিতে হরিসঙ্কীর্তনে নৃত্য ।
দেখিয়া সকল লোক আনন্দিত-চিত্ত ॥ ৭০ ॥

bālaka-sahite harisaṅkīrtane nṛtya |
dekhiẏā sakala loka ānandita-citta || 70 ||

balaka-sahite — with the boys; hari-sankirtane nritya — dancing in Hari's sankirtana; dekhiya — seeing; sakala loka — all the people; anandita-chitta — joyful at heart

70with the boys He dances in the sankirtana of Hari —
seeing it, everyone rejoices at heart;

যেনমতে হাতে খড়ি দিলা তাঁর বাপ ।
যা শুনিলে দূরে যায় অমঙ্গল-তাপ ॥ ৭১ ॥

yenamate hāte khaṛi dilā tāṁra bāpa |
yā śunile dūre yāẏa amaṅgala-tāpa || 71 ||

yenamate — how; hate khadi dila — put the chalk in His hand (start of writing lessons); tanra bapa — His father; ya shunile — hearing which; dure yaya — goes far away; amangala-tapa — the fever of misfortune

71how His father put the chalk [for writing] in His hand —
hearing of it, the fever of misfortune goes far away;

তবে ত কহিব কথা শুন সাবধানে ।
খেলে বিশ্বম্ভর বিশ্বরূপ জ্যেষ্ঠ-সনে ॥ ৭২ ॥

tabe ta kahiba kathā śuna sābadhāne |
khele biśbambhara biśbarūpa jyeṣṭha-sane || 72 ||

tabe ta kahiba katha — then I shall tell; shuna savadhane — listen attentively; khele vishvambhara — Vishvambhara plays; vishvarupa jyeshtha-sane — with the elder, Vishvarupa

72then I shall tell — listen attentively —
how Vishvambhara plays with the elder, Vishvarupa:

ইন্দ্র উপেন্দ্র যেন দুই সহোদর ।
কহিব তাহার কথা শুনিবে উত্তর ॥ ৭৩ ॥

indra upendra yena dui sahodara |
kahiba tāhāra kathā śunibe uttara || 73 ||

indra upendra — Indra and Upendra; yena — as if; dui sahodara — two brothers of one womb; kahiba tahara katha — I shall tell of them; shunibe uttara — you will hear later

73like two brothers born of one womb, Indra and Upendra;
I shall tell of them — you will hear later;

বিশ্বরূপ সন্ন্যাস করিলা যেনমতে ।
বিশ্বম্ভর পিতা-মাতা প্রবোধে কথাতে ॥ ৭৪ ॥

biśbarūpa sannyāsa karilā yenamate |
biśbambhara pitā-mātā prabodhe kathāte || 74 ||

vishvarupa — Vishvarupa; sannyasa karila — took sannyasa; yenamate — how; vishvambhara — Vishvambhara; pita-mata prabodhe — consoles father and mother; kathate — with words

74how Vishvarupa took sannyasa,
and how Vishvambhara consoled father and mother with words;

তবে ত কহিব বিশ্বম্ভরের চরিত ।
বালক-সহিতে খেলা খেলে বিপরীত ॥ ৭৫ ॥

tabe ta kahiba biśbambharera carita |
bālaka-sahite khelā khele biparīta || 75 ||

tabe ta kahiba — then I shall tell; vishvambharera charita — Vishvambhara's deeds; balaka-sahite — with the children; khela khele viparita — He plays wild (lit. "contrary") games

75then I shall tell of Vishvambhara's deeds:
how He played wild games with the children —

সকল বালক মেলি জাহ্নবীর কূলে ।
বালুকায় পক্ষ-পদচিহ্ন দেখি বুলে ॥ ৭৬ ॥

sakala bālaka meli jāhnabīra kūle |
bālukāẏa pakṣa-padacihna dekhi bule || 76 ||

sakala balaka meli — all the boys together; jahnavira kule — on the bank of the Jahnavi; balukaya — on the sand; paksha-pada-chihna — bird tracks; dekhi bule — following them they roam

76all the boys together on the bank of the Jahnavi
run over the sand, following the tracks of birds;

দেখিয়া তাঁহার পিতা দুঃখী হৈল মন ।
ঘরেরে আনিয়া কৈলা তর্জন-গর্জন ॥ ৭৭ ॥

dekhiẏā tāṁhāra pitā duḥkhī haila mana |
gharere āniẏā kailā tarjana-garjana || 77 ||

dekhiya — seeing; tanhara pita — His father; duhkhi haila mana — was grieved at heart; gharere aniya — bringing Him home; kaila tarjana-garjana — scolded and shouted

77seeing this, His father was grieved at heart,
brought Him home and scolded Him;

স্বপনে তাঁহারে কৃপা কৈলা যেনমতে ।
কহিব সকল কথা শুন একচিতে ॥ ৭৮ ॥

sbapane tāṁhāre kṛpā kailā yenamate |
kahiba sakala kathā śuna ekacite || 78 ||

svapane — in a dream; tanhare kripa kaila — showed him mercy; yenamate — how; kahiba sakala katha — I shall tell all; shuna eka-chite — listen with one mind

78how [the Lord] showed him mercy in a dream —
I shall tell it all, listen with one mind;

কর্ণবেধ চূড়াকর্ম আর উপবীত ।
কহিব সকল কথা আনন্দিত-চিত ॥ ৭৯ ॥

karṇabedha cūṛākarma āra upabīta |
kahiba sakala kathā ānandita-cita || 79 ||

karnavedha — ear-piercing; chuda-karma — chudakarana (first tonsure); ara upavita — and the sacred thread; kahiba sakala katha — I shall tell it all; anandita-chita — with a joyful heart

79the ear-piercing, the chudakarana and the sacred thread —
I shall tell it all with a joyful heart;

বাল্যসমাধানে হৈলে যৌবনপ্রবেশ ।
দিনে দিনে করে প্রেমার প্রকাশ অশেষ ॥ ৮০ ॥

bālyasamādhāne haile yaubanaprabeśa |
dine dine kare premāra prakāśa aśeṣa || 80 ||

balya-samadhane — at the close of childhood; haile yauvana-pravesha — when youth began; dine dine — day by day; kare premara prakasha — He manifests prema; ashesha — without end

80childhood ended, He enters youth,
day by day manifesting prema without end;

গুরুস্থানে পড়িলেন সতীর্থের সনে ।
বঙ্গজের কথায় পরিহাসয়ে যেমনে ॥ ৮১ ॥

gurusthāne paṛilena satīrthera sane |
baṅgajera kathāẏa parihāsaẏe yemane || 81 ||

guru-sthane — at the guru's place; padilena — He studied; satirthera sane — with fellow students; bangajera kathaya — at the speech of the East Bengalis; parihasaye yemane — how He made fun

81He studied with His guru together with His fellow students,
how He mimicked the speech of the people of East Bengal;19

✦

Notes

  1. The summary printed in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition before this section is almost wholly illegible in the OCR (only scattered words can be made out — a list of the coming pastimes: Vishvarupa's sannyasa, the passing of Jagannatha Mishra, the journey to East Bengal, etc.). We therefore give his own brief summary of this section from the Khanda-vivarana (survey of the parts) at the beginning of the same edition.
  2. In Bhaktisiddhanta's edition the shloka is followed by his Sanskrit commentary. He explains: "in the age of Kali" — "in the age of quarrel"; "to free the devotees from their distress" — to give the Lord's servants a joy free of thorns when they are troubled by disputants opposed to shruti; "descended in full" — appeared in His original form as Bhagavan (svayam-rupa); "crest-jewel of sannyasis" — the jewel in the crown of renunciants, full of beauty; "bhakti and prema" — service of the Lord, and prema, which is nothing but the desire to please Krishna's senses — these are the priceless jewels, and "giving away" means bestowing them freely; "the devotees" — those devoted to pure service; "the unbelievers" — those hostile to the devotees and turned away from Hari; "crushes" — subdues completely; "glory to" — may He abide above all.
  3. Ganesha, Shiva with Parvati, and Sarasvati are praised here after the custom of the Bengali mangala poems. For Gaudiya Vaishnavas the gods are honoured as devotees of the Lord: Ganesha worships Govinda (Brahma-samhita 5.50), and Shiva is the greatest of Vaishnavas (Bhag. 12.13.16); so too Bhaktisiddhanta, in his summary of the next section, calls Shambhu "the best of Vaishnavas". The words "the sole doers in the three worlds" are poetic praise; for the tradition the source of all the worlds is Krishna Himself, and Shiva and Parvati are His servants, "granting bhakti to Vishnu", as the same line says.
  4. Literally "unknown to the three worlds, in greatness — to the Lord of speech"; the Lord of speech (Vaninatha) is Brahma, husband of Sarasvati. The 1903 edition reads "to the golden [Lord], the Lord of speech"; the sense of the line is not quite clear in either reading.
  5. So in Bhaktisiddhanta's text (and in his index of names — "Garga"): Garga Muni, the family priest of the Yadavas, who in Gaura-lila is Nilambara Chakravarti, the Lord's maternal grandfather (Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika). The 1983 edition reads here "brimming over, enraptured with pride in Gora's virtues" and refers the line to Nityananda.
  6. The Lord's first wife, Lakshmipriya, left the world while the Lord was in East Bengal (see en/02, v. 86).
  7. In the 1983 edition this couplet stands right after the praise of Shachi (v. 20); we follow the order of Bhaktisiddhanta's edition.
  8. Pandita Gosani is Gadadhara Pandita.
  9. That is, Murari Gupta the physician (vaidya, physician, also the physician caste).
  10. "Master of the family" and "chosen Deity" (ishta-devata) here mean Narahari himself, the author's guru, named in the next couplet.
  11. Vrindavana Dasa's Sri Chaitanya-bhagavata.
  12. Literally "the Thakura of our house"; this usually means the household Deity (at Shrikhanda, Gopinatha). The 1983 edition reads: "I praise the Thakura of our house, Sri Raghunandana", i.e. Raghunandana himself is so called.
  13. V. 36+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; it is absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition and from the 1903 edition. On Raghunandana and his father Mukunda Dasa cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 15.112–131.
  14. Sri Murti — the Deity. According to the tradition of Shrikhanda, the boy Raghunandana, son of Mukunda Dasa (Narahari's brother), gave a laddu to the Deity of Gopinatha, and the Deity ate it.
  15. The line is damaged in the OCR of Bhaktisiddhanta's edition; translated from the legible reading. The 1903 and 1983 editions have: "Sing the virtues of Gora — this is my hope; Lochana Dasa says: fulfil my desire."
  16. The identification of Murari Gupta with Hanuman is also accepted by Kavi Karnapura's Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika.
  17. Murari Gupta's Sri Krishna-chaitanya-charitamrita, a Sanskrit poem framed as Murari's dialogue with Damodara Pandita (translated in `murari-gupta/`). Bhaktisiddhanta in his survey of the parts calls it Sri Chaitanya-charita.
  18. Advaita Acharya.
  19. The people of East Bengal (bangaja) spoke a dialect that was thought comic in Navadvipa; in His youth the Lord loved to mimic it.
